expected_behavior_change: Every online web surface revalidates current cloud data on bootstrap before presenting current state.
Customer, Owner and SMM replace repeated polling/focus/page checks with the shared passive canonical doorbell.
Doorbell notifications trigger one canonical snapshot pull; reconnect/online recovery triggers one catch-up pull.
Admin startup never reinterprets cached release history as a new publish command and can recover a stale Admin session once during publish.
Admin, Customer, Owner and SMM HTML shells revalidate on navigation while hashed assets remain immutable.
Safari back-forward cache restores reload the web shell once.
SMM service-worker online reads bypass browser HTTP cache while retaining explicit offline fallback.
Public SMT becomes an ungated PUBLIC_MIRROR built from the same v2local source as the physical runtime; provider/order/print side-effect consumers remain disabled in the mirror.
Customer hardcoded historical build identity is removed.
non_goals: No second Order, Pricing, Payment, Print, Keeta or config authority.
No service worker added to Admin, Customer or Owner.
No public SMT transaction authority or physical print authority.
